notes.fine_step_vs_precision: Interpretation (accepted by lead pending spec enrichment): precision = declared DISPLAY decimal places; step=10^-precision, fine_step=step/10 and coarse_step=step*10 are DERIVED (STU-FX-110), fine_step may be finer than the display precision. Stored/accepted values keep full parsed precision; nothing rounds to precision silently. Step arithmetic only strips binary noise (1e-9 grid below 1e6).

notes.step_at_hard_bound: Spec is SILENT on an arrow/accessibility step that would leave the hard range (STU-FX-110 defines step/fine/coarse; STU-FX-110a: only pointer scrubbing clamps, typed/non-pointer values reject). Kept: such a step is REJECTED with OutOfHardBounds(Int); the pointer route is the only clamping route.

fixed.cause: clean() rounded to a fixed 1e-9 grid while precision 9 is legal (MAX_PRECISION) and fine_step = 1e-10, so step_value(0.5,+1,Fine) returned Ok(0.5) and ValueStore::set answered Ok(None)
fixed.fix: clean(x, precision) grid = 10^-max(9, precision+1), rounding while |x| < 1e15/scale (behaviour identical for precision <= 8); ScrubGesture::drag uses the same grid via new pub field ScrubParams.precision; step_value refuses a number step that leaves the value unchanged (f64 resolution at large magnitude, e.g. 1e7 at precision 9) with new typed ControlError::StepNoEffect (code step_no_effect) instead of Ok(same); descriptor stays registrable (STU-FX-110 fine_step = 10^-(precision+1) kept normative)

remediation_R5.shared_rule: ControlSpec::moved (crate-private, descriptor.rs): a discrete move must name a direction and land on a value different from current, else StepNoEffect; a changed target then passes validate_value (hard bounds reject).
